facts.P1_fx_receipts: Yes; only receipts of USD 1 million or more must be brought home.
facts.P2_fcy_account: Yes: foreign-currency deposit (FCD) accounts at Thai banks.
facts.P3_local_gateways: Local gateways like Omise and 2C2P weren't researched yet.
facts.L1_registration: A sole proprietorship needs no official registration, but you need a taxpayer number.
facts.L2_tax_id: Apply for a Tax Identification Number within 60 days of first income.
facts.L3_income_tax_foreign: Foreign income earned since 2024 is taxed when brought into Thailand.
facts.L4_vat_gst: 7% VAT above THB 1.8 million; services used abroad can be zero-rated.
facts.L5_data_protection: PDPA 2019, fully in force since June 2022.
facts.L6_consumer_ecommerce: Online buyers may cancel in writing within 7 days of receiving goods.

watch_out.text: Foreign income from 2024 onward is taxed when you bring it in, any year.
Platforms paying via PayPal Payouts may not reach Thai accounts.
